name: Thuy Tran

bio.statement: Tran's official biography says she has owned and operated Rose City Vision since 1995.
bio.excerpt: has owned and operated Rose City Vision since 1995.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Tran member page

bio.statement: Her campaign site describes her as a mom, immigrant, doctor, and Lieutenant Colonel in the Oregon Air National Guard.
bio.excerpt: As a mom, immigrant, Doctor, Lieutenant Colonel in the Oregon Air National Guard, and a local small business owner

bio.statement: Her official page says she chaired the House Committee on Emergency Management, General Government, and Veterans in the 2025 session.
bio.excerpt: chaired the House Committee On Emergency Management, General Government, and Veterans

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Tran member page

positions.statement: In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Tran listed health care for all Oregonians, with investments in prevention and continuum of care, as a theme.
positions.excerpt: Healthcare for all Oregonians with investments in prevention and continuum of care

positions.statement: In the same 2024 survey, Tran listed mitigating climate change effects as a theme.
positions.excerpt: Protecting our environment and Oregonians by mitigating climate change negative effects

positions.statement: In the same 2024 survey, Tran listed community safety, housing and jobs as a theme.
positions.excerpt: Uplift Oregonians with community safety, housing, jobs and a fair shot at the American Dream.
